variant.changelog:
Chocoholic functions available. No requirement for chocoholic. Internal functions run silent with no effect, if Chocoholic is not available/loaded.

Update-Information for loaded scripts.

Auto-re-download scripts missing in the script directory if the script was loaded before over the load scripts tab.

Configuration-Support for scripts integrated.
